features.heading: Series & Data

features.heading: Axis Types
features.detail: Category, number, time, and log axes, with customisable ticks and labels.

features.detail: Add secondary axes to compare series with different scales.

features.heading: Legends
features.detail: Configurable positioning, pagination, and interactive series toggling.

features.heading: Cross Lines
features.detail: Add references lines and ranges to mark thresholds and targets.

features.heading: Conditional Styling

features.heading: Themes
features.detail: Five built-in themes with light and dark variants. Create custom themes to match your design system.

features.heading: Fills & Strokes
features.detail: Solid colours, gradients, patterns, and image fills for series styling.

features.heading: Markers
features.detail: Configurable shapes, sizes, and styles for data point markers.

features.heading: Tooltips
features.detail: Built-in tooltips with multiple display modes and custom renderers.

features.heading: Highlighting
features.detail: Hover states for items and series with configurable styles.

features.heading: Events
features.detail: Event callbacks for series, legend, and chart elements.

features.heading: Zoom & Pan

features.heading: Context Menu
features.detail: Right-click menus with configurable actions and export options.

features.heading: Navigator

items.question: Is AG Charts free to use?
items.answer: AG Charts Community is free and open-source under the MIT license. Use it in commercial projects without restrictions. [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) adds financial charts, maps, annotations, and advanced interactivity.

items.question: What chart types are included?
items.answer: AG Charts includes 30+ chart types: Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, Pie, Donut, Radar, Treemap, Sunburst, Heatmap, Candlestick, OHLC, Maps, Gauges, and more. Browse the [Gallery](/gallery/) to see them all.

items.question: Does AG Charts support TypeScript?
items.answer: Yes. AG Charts is written in TypeScript and ships with full type definitions. The Angular integration works seamlessly with Angular's strict type checking.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Install with `npm install ag-charts-angular ag-charts-community`, import the `AgCharts` component, and bind your options. The [Quick Start guide](./quick-start/) walks through a complete example.

items.question: Does AG Charts have any dependencies?
items.answer: No, AG Charts is a dependency-free library. It uses native browser APIs and the HTML5 canvas for rendering.

items.question: What's included in AG Charts Enterprise?
items.answer: [AG Charts Enterprise](/license-pricing/) includes Financial Charts with annotations, Maps, Gauges, Zoom, Crosshairs, Navigator, and Context Menus. Start a free trial to evaluate.

items.question: How does AG Charts handle large datasets?
items.answer: AG Charts uses canvas-based rendering optimised for large data with the M4 algorithm. Learn more in our [blog](https://blog.ag-grid.com/optimizing-large-data-set-visualisations-with-the-m4-algorithm/).

items.question: Can I use AG Charts with AG Grid?
items.answer: Yes. AG Charts powers the [Integrated Charts](https://www.ag-grid.com/angular-data-grid/integrated-charts/) feature in AG Grid, allowing users to create charts directly from grid data.
